name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
description: World's largest government-funded health assurance scheme providing health cover of ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.

benefit.description: Cashless and paperless access to services for the beneficiary at empaneled public and private hospitals up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year. Covers 3 days pre-hospitalization and 15 days post-hospitalization expenses.

general: Identified as per Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011) deprivation criteria or active NFSA ration card
All senior citizens aged 70 and above are eligible for Ayushman Vay Vandana Card irrespective of income
No restriction on family size, age, or gender
otherConditions: Must present Ayushman Card / Golden Card at empaneled hospital

eligibilityChecks.question: Does your family have a BPL / NFSA Ration Card or SECC 2011 listing?
Are you or a family member aged 70 years or older?

requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Ration Card / Food Security Card / Family ID
Passport-size photo (captured via webcam during card creation)
applicationProcess: Visit official portal (beneficiary.nha.gov.in) or download the Ayushman App
Enter mobile number and authenticate via OTP
Search family using State, District, Aadhaar Number, or Family ID / Ration Card number
Perform e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP or Biometrics (Face/Fingerprint)
Instant Ayushman Card approval and download PVC / Digital Card

applicationWindow.details: Continuous card issuance and hospital cashless claims 24x7

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / National Health Authority
aiContext: Provides ₹5 Lakh cashless hospital treatment per family per year at empaneled hospitals across India. Covers pre-existing conditions from day one. Senior citizens 70+ get top-up ₹5 Lakh cover.

faqs.question: Are pre-existing diseases covered under PM-JAY?
faqs.answer: Yes, all pre-existing medical conditions are covered from day one of enrollment without any waiting period.

faqs.question: How do senior citizens aged 70+ get benefits?
faqs.answer: All citizens aged 70+ receive the Ayushman Vay Vandana Card with a dedicated ₹5 Lakh cover regardless of their family income.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
description: Direct financial incentive to pregnant women and lactating mothers for partial wage loss compensation and ensuring nutritious health care during first and second child.

benefit.description: ₹5,000 in 2 installments for the first child (₹3,000 at pregnancy registration & antenatal checkup, ₹2,000 at child birth & vaccination). For 2nd child (if a girl), ₹6,000 in a single installment.

general: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM) who are Indian citizens
Must be registered at Anganwadi Centre (AWC) / approved Health Facility within 570 days of LMP date
Applicable for first live child; additional benefit of ₹6,000 if the second child born is a girl
otherConditions: Women in regular employment with Central/State Govt or PSUs receiving paid maternity leave are excluded

eligibilityChecks.question: Are you a pregnant woman or lactating mother registered with Anganwadi/Health Center?
Is this your first pregnancy, or second child where newborn is a girl?
Are you NOT a regular government employee receiving paid maternity leave?

requiredDocuments: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card / RCH ID
Aadhaar-seeded Bank Passbook of the Mother
Child Birth Certificate & Immunization Record (for 2nd installment)
applicationProcess: Register pregnancy at nearest Anganwadi Centre or on PMMVY portal (pmmvy.wcd.gov.in)
Submit MCP card details and minimum one Antenatal Check-up (ANC) record
Anganwadi Worker / ASHA worker verifies documents and submits online
DBT payment transferred directly to mother's Aadhaar-linked bank account

applicationWindow.details: Apply within 570 days of Last Menstrual Period (LMP)

ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
aiContext: Provides ₹5,000 for 1st child (in 2 installments) and ₹6,000 for 2nd child if girl child. Direct bank transfer for nutrition and medical checks.

faqs.question: Can I apply for the second child?
faqs.answer: Yes, under PMMVY 2.0, if the second child is a girl, a direct financial incentive of ₹6,000 is given in a single installment.

faqs.question: Is mother's Aadhaar mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, the mother's Aadhaar number and Aadhaar-seeded bank account are mandatory.

name: Dr. YSR Aarogyasri Scheme
description: Andhra Pradesh government flagship health scheme providing cashless medical treatment up to ₹25 Lakh for over 3,250 medical procedures at empaneled hospitals.

benefit.description: Cashless treatment up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year covering surgeries, therapies, medicines, food, and post-operative financial support under Aarogya Aasara (₹225/day or ₹5,000/month during recovery).

general: Must be a resident of Andhra Pradesh holding a valid Rice Card / Aarogyasri Card
Annual household income must be below ₹5,00,000
Total landholding less than 35 acres (dry or wet combined as per rules)
otherConditions: Family must not own a four-wheeler (except taxi/tractor/auto)

eligibilityChecks.question: Do you hold a valid Andhra Pradesh Rice Card or Aarogyasri Card?
Is your family total annual income below ₹5,00,000?

requiredDocuments: Aarogyasri Card / Rice Card / BPL Ration Card
Aadhaar Card of patient and family head
Doctor Referral / Prescription from Govt Hospital or Empaneled Hospital
Bank Account Passbook (for Aarogya Aasara recovery allowance)
applicationProcess: Visit any network hospital in Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad, Chennai, or Bengaluru
Meet the Aarogya Mithra desk at the hospital entrance
Aarogya Mithra verifies Rice Card / Aadhaar details on the portal
Pre-authorization approved online within 2 hours; cashless treatment begins immediately
Post-discharge Aarogya Aasara allowance credited to patient's account

applicationWindow.details: Instant 24x7 emergency and planned admission at hospital Aarogya Mithra desk

verification: Dr. YSR Aarogyasri Health Care Trust
ministry: Department of Health, Medical and Family Welfare, Government of Andhra Pradesh
aiContext: Andhra Pradesh scheme providing up to ₹25 Lakh cashless hospital treatment for 3,250+ procedures at network hospitals in AP, Hyderabad, Chennai, Bengaluru + Aarogya Aasara post-op cash support.

faqs.question: Can I get treatment outside Andhra Pradesh under Aarogyasri?
faqs.answer: Yes, over 150 super-specialty hospitals in Hyderabad, Chennai, and Bengaluru are empaneled for high-end surgeries.

faqs.question: What is Aarogya Aasara?
faqs.answer: It is post-operative wage assistance given during the doctor-advised recovery period (₹225/day up to ₹5,000/month) directly via DBT.
